threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the distribution ERP and warehouse systems and halts supply to hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ERP in the colocation data center serves 24 distribution centers
regulatory_driver: N42-R01 (FTC Act Sec. 5); N42-R07 (Form 8-K Item 1.05; 17 CFR 229.106)
treatment_plan: Disaster recovery replica in provider B; ransomware recovery test

threat_event: An attacker uses automation vendor access to disrupt distribution center sortation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor access through PAM, but automation logs not in the SIEM

threat_event: Distribution lacks a CMMC Level 1 status when DoD exercises the 2027-03-31 option
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No self-assessment against FAR 52.204-21; no SPRS affirmation; FCI boundary undefined

threat_event: Distribution ships IX-3 or IX-4 stock affected by a device correction before a hold takes effect
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hold requests arrive by email; lot trace export manual
treatment_plan: Electronic hold interface from the Medical Devices eQMS

threat_event: Federal contract information in email and file shares is not protected as FAR 52.204-21 requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI outside the ERP role controls

threat_event: A colocation data center outage halts order-to-cash and warehouse operations
existing_controls: Nightly backups to the vault; manual order workaround
treatment_plan: Warm replica in provider B (group plan GR-15)

threat_event: Distribution assumes group controls that do not cover its systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance undocumented; supplement not updated for 2026 policies
treatment_plan: Distribution inheritance matrix and supplement re-issue

threat_event: Cybersecurity-related device complaints are not captured in distributor complaint files or passed to manufacturers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complaint intake form has no cybersecurity prompt
treatment_plan: Add cybersecurity prompts; forward to manufacturers

threat_event: Covered telecommunications equipment is found in distribution center video systems and not reported in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual representation relies on supplier attestations
treatment_plan: Inventory check of video equipment brands

threat_event: An EDI partner compromise leads to fraudulent orders or invoices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EDI partners authenticate with shared credentials on older connections
existing_controls: Transaction limits; review of new ship-to addresses

threat_event: A customer ordering portal account is taken over and used to place fraudulent orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for non-administrator customer users
treatment_plan: Make MFA default for all customer users

threat_event: AI demand forecasting errors cause stockouts of critical supplies
Visitors at distribution centers are not logged or escorted as FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(ix) requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper logs incomplete at 5 of 8 sampled sites

threat_event: A private-label program makes the division a manufacturer without a quality system
treatment_plan: Proposal stays on hold until a QMS and registration plan is approved

threat_event: Shared accounts on warehouse handheld scanners hide who moved stock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Handhelds sign in with site accounts

threat_event: Importer MDR reports are filed late because intake is manual
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual review of complaints for importer lines
treatment_plan: Daily review of complaints for importer product lines
